name: Osada Yukiko
source:
Pretty and quiet girl with glasses, she's not many friends and brings always a book with her, everywhere, to read when she's alone. In class is always quiet and has good grades, almost buried alive in school. Although she's not being bullied, her presence isn't very noticeable even when isolated.
